title.narrative: CEG Policy dialogue for a democratic Guatemala 2024-2025
CEG Policydialog för ett demokratiskt Guatemala 2024-2025

description.narrative:
Contribution 16855 Policy dialogue for a democratic Guatemala will support civil society in formulating proposals for democratic reforms, human rights, gender equality, and environmental protection in dialogue with members of Guatemala's congress, with the aim of supporting democratic dialogue and collaboration between congress, government, and civil society.
Objective 1: Strengthen the capacity of key state and non-state actors for the comprehensive protection of human rights defenders, especially those who promote justice, through policy proposals and legal support.
Objective 2: Strengthen the articulation and the drafting of proposals with allies in Guatemala's congress in favor of human rights, women's rights, the Escazú Agreement, and the Water Law (Ley de Agua), among other themes and issues.
Objective 3: Produce information on the political context, the justice sector, politics, and proposals against corruption and impunity.
Objective 4: Establish and consolidate a space of trust and coordination with the new 2024-2028 government for the promotion of coordinated and complementary agendas and intersectoral dialogue on human rights, security and justice, and an efficient and democratic government.

Insatsen syftar till att främja demokratiska samtal och policyutveckling rörande demokrati, mänskliga rättigheter, jämställdhet, rättsstatens principer och miljö i samverkan med guatemalanska kongressledamöter och civilsamhället.

The contribution aims to promote democratic conversations and policy development to promote democracy, human rights, gender equality, rule of law, and the environment in coordination with members of Guatemala's congress and civil society.
